Three Little Birds by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Grayton Beach. A very sought-after area along scenic Highway 30A. And lucky for you, this gorgeous, 4 bedroom, 4 bath house is tucked away in a very vibrant neighborhood. Built in 2021, and comfortably accommodating up to 10 guests, Three Little Birds has a contemporary flair, with distressed plank-style flooring throughout. A true haven for sand lovers, the home is a quick shuttle trip, or bike ride, to the beach. Inside, the modern kitchen, with new appliances, features a spacious island perfect for gathering. The dining area is poised to host intimate dinners for 8, while the uncluttered living space ensures a comfortable and inviting ambiance. A guest room, queen, is on the lower level, for those who prefer to avoid stairs.

Upstairs, discover two primary bedrooms, king, and a charming bunk room with 4 twin beds. The immediate surroundings are enriched by the presence of the laid-back village known as Grayton Beach—an enticing backdrop to your coastal getaway. Take a bike, or the free shuttle, to the Red Bar area during the day or night. A couple cool shops, a few very nice restaurants, it feels different here, distinct from the rest of 30A. Ready for the white sand? Either visit the Grayton Beach State Park for a serene escape, or follow the cars and trucks to the beach for another uniquely 'Grayton' scene! The Grayton Dunes Beach Access, bordered by the outfall of Western Lake, is beyond explanation. This is the spot, friends. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 1.2 miles to the beach (Grayton Beach Access) - 4 bedroom, 4 bath - 2336 sq ft - Wi-Fi - 4 bikes included - Community pool - Propane grill - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog - 2 parking spots maximum Overnight: - Queen in 1st floor guest room; shared bath; TV - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV - 2 twin over twin bunk in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
